Example 3
: Conducting a Hypothesis Test- Comparing Publisher vs. Free Online Homework
In the fall 2020 semester, a Math professor switched from using a publisher’s online homework management
system to a free system called MyOpenMath. The publisher’s system cost students $120 each to use, while
the MyOpenMath system was free to use. The professor decided to compare homework grades using each
of the two systems. He had data from 10 class sections using the publisher’s online homework system, and
data from 4 class sections using the free system. You can copy the
homework data
The mean homework grade prior to 2020 was 70.02, based on 10 classes taught between 2016 and 2020.
The homework grades using the free system, based on 4 classes taught between 2020 and 2022, are listed in
Table 5
. Test the claim that the mean homework grades were higher using the free system. In other words,
test that the mean homework grade of students using the free system (MyOpenMath) is higher than 70.02.
Use significance level 0.05.
